key_finding: The non-Markovian coherence is distinguishable from the Markov exponential in the TIME DOMAIN. The signature is: (1) Gaussian initial decay at t < tau_B (visible in log C vs t^2 plot), (2) Coherence ABOVE the Markov exponential at early times, (3) Convergence to Markov at t >> tau_B. The gamma_dataset (single 1/e-point per frequency) cannot see this. A full Ramsey trace with dense time sampling can.

gaussian_diagnostic.method: Plot log(C(t)) vs t^2. Straight line = Gaussian (NM). Curved upward = exponential (Markov).

cramer_rao.note: tau_B above this threshold is measurable to <10% with 10k shots

experimental_requirement.key_window: 0 to tau_B  (where Gaussian onset is visible)

connection_to_C2: tau_B is the substrate bath correlation time — the memory of the C2 PRW substrate. In the Markov limit tau_B -> 0, the substrate has no memory and all predictions are identical to standard Lindblad. A measured tau_B > 0 (NMP > 0.1) would be evidence that the substrate has a finite correlation time, which is a non-trivial statement about the microscopic dynamics.
